nodes.text: Use a Druid for this class-restricted toy. Choose Firelands Normal or Heroic yourself and enter the raid in southern Mount Hyjal; inspect this character’s lockout first.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Clear trash through the opening Firelands field until Shannox and his hounds arrive. Defeat his patrol before continuing. Running past the field without spawning him leaves the later bridge locked.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Take the web-covered branch to Beth’tilac. Use the silk strand left by a Cinderweb Spinner to reach her web when necessary, then finish the encounter after she descends.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Take the volcanic path to Lord Rhyolith’s plateau. Damage his legs to steer him across active volcanoes and remove armor; finish him when he enters his final phase.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Continue to Alysrazor’s arena and begin the encounter at the feather/roleplay event. Handle the ground enemies and fire tornadoes, then defeat her through the burnout and re-ignition cycle if required.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: With the four outdoor bosses cleared, take the main path up to Baleroc and defeat him. Check the raid map for any of Shannox, Beth’tilac, Rhyolith or Alysrazor still alive before approaching the orb.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Behind Baleroc’s gate, use the Magma Orb to form the bridge. Cross to the keep and continue to Majordomo Staghelm’s courtyard.

recovery.text: The orb requires the preceding bosses; Shannox is commonly missed. If all five are dead but its dialogue is unavailable, preserve the save and report the obstruction rather than jumping around the gate.

nodes.text: Defeat Majordomo Staghelm in the courtyard and loot for Fandral’s Seed Pouch. Adapt the group’s spread/stack to his scorpion and cat forms; do not confuse the temporary Burning Seeds on the ground with the toy.

recovery.text: The pouch is a random drop, not a guaranteed reward for a Druid or a Burning Seed pickup. Normal and Heroic have separate current Firelands loot saves; respect each observed character/difficulty opportunity.

nodes.writtenDestination: Firelands: use the Magma Orb behind Baleroc, cross its bridge into the keep, and continue into Majordomo Staghelm’s courtyard before Ragnaros’s chamber.

nodes.text: Use Fandral’s Seed Pouch from your bags to learn the toy.

recovery.text: Only Toy Box ownership finishes this goal. Loot, mail, an achievement and the guide cursor remain separate evidence.
